title: AWKUM Places 20 Students as Interns at NCHD Mardan
text:
The Career Counseling
and Placement Center (CCPC) of Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM) has
placed 20 students as interns at the National Commission for Human Development
(NCHD), Mardan Office, for a one-month internship program.

During the internship,
the students will be involved and contribute to community development
initiatives, including awareness campaigns, educational support, and community
engagement activities under the guidance of NCHD professionals.

This collaboration
reflects AWKUM's commitment to providing students with practical learning
opportunities that enhance their professional skills, social responsibility,
and career readiness. The University appreciates NCHD Mardan for partnering in
this valuable initiative and looks forward to strengthening future
collaborations that empower students through experiential learning.

The CCPC Team remains committed
to realizing the vision of the Vice Chancellor, Prof. Dr. Jamil Ahmad, by
strengthening academia–industry linkages and providing students with meaningful
experiential learning opportunities. Through these initiatives, CCPC equips the
students with the practical skills, professional competencies, and confidence
required to thrive in the workforce and contribute effectively to society.
